title: Flame outlines
description: One camera's flame outlines for every instant of a flame analysis event, in the order of the event's instants. Each ring is a closed polygon given as a flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] list in full-resolution pixel coordinates: x right, y down, a pixel's centre at integer coordinates (as fireplan's Camera.project). Rings are filled with the even-odd rule, so a ring inside another is a hole. An instant with no flame has no rings.
